clue.text: Fair amount? Strike!

definitions.meaning: a fair ... is a reasonable share or portion of something
to strike is to hit hard, a smack or thump

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses of one word: an informal share or portion, and a heavy blow delivered to someone.

clue.text: Opposed in two ways, party hit back before elected

indicators.note: the phrase in two ways means the rest sits between the two copies of the abbreviation
two asks for the abbreviation for ways to appear twice over

parts.note: ST, short for street, a way or road

indicators.note: before puts the reversed song directly ahead of the letters for elected
back means the party hit is written from right to left

parts.note: Agadoo, the 1984 Black Lace song played at every wedding disco
a politician who is elected is IN

explanation.surface: A candidate opposed by rivals hits back at a party just before winning the election.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'party hit' is a famously naff 1984 British novelty song by Black Lace, a staple of wedding discos; 'in two ways' means between two abbreviations for street.
explanation.definitionFit: To have stood against someone is to have opposed them, especially as a rival candidate at an election.

clue.text: Not entirely luxurious benefit

indicators.note: not entirely tells us the synonym for luxurious loses its final letter

parts.note: plush means luxurious, opulent

explanation.surface: A perk that is not quite as lavish as it could be.
explanation.definitionFit: A plus is an advantage or bonus, a point in something's favour.

clue.text: Political institution dispensing with French leader from afar, Marine Le Pen up to no good

indicators.note: no good suggests the letters are in a bad state, so they are thrown into disorder; up to is part of the material
dispensing with means one letter is dropped from the word afar
leader picks out the opening letter of the word French

explanation.surface: Marine Le Pen, the French far-right politician, is plotting mischief against a distant institution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' is a link: the F (French leader) goes from AFAR, leaving AAR, which joins MARINELEPENUPTO to be rearranged; 'no good' is the indicator, 'up to' belonging to the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: The Strasbourg assembly of elected members is the legislative body of the EU, a political institution.

clue.text: Arenas in development finally breaking down, perfect when up

indicators.note: breaking means the final letter cuts into the word for down

parts.note: feeling down is feeling sad

indicators.note: finally picks out the last letter of the word development
in a down clue, up means the word for perfect is read from bottom to top

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, perfect, written with the digit as the letter I

explanation.surface: Stadium construction is ending in a slump, though things look perfect when they recover.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 (first-class) is written AI, and reversed gives IA.
explanation.definitionFit: Stadia is the Latin plural of stadium, so arenas for sport.

clue.text: Huge beasts once beating toads in battle

indicators.note: in places the rearranged toads inside the name of the battle

parts.note: Mons, in Belgium, was the site of a famous First World War battle

indicators.note: beating suggests the toads are knocked about, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Great creatures long ago thrashing amphibians in combat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'battle' is not the anagram signal but a specific battle, Mons in Belgium, fought in 1914; 'beating' is the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: These were extinct elephant-like animals, enormous creatures that lived long ago, hence once.

clue.text: Number of connected rooms in silhouette?

indicators.note: the letters found in silhouette, with the question mark hinting they must be rearranged to fit the definition
this word means the letters it governs are mixed up, so they are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Seeing a block of rooms only as a dark outline.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer uses exactly the letters of 'silhouette'; the question mark flags that they are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A suite is a set of rooms opening into one another, and a hotel's are numbered.

clue.text: Instrument in need of tuning, first off

indicators.note: first off removes the opening letter of the word for out of tune

parts.note: a note that is sharp is pitched too high and needs tuning

explanation.surface: A musical instrument that needs tuning before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: The harp is a stringed musical instrument plucked by hand.

clue.text: Average place to host a tapeworm, say?

indicators.note: to host means the outer letters take the A in as a guest

parts.note: par is the standard or average level
a site is a place or location

explanation.surface: An ordinary spot where a tapeworm might live.
explanation.definitionFit: A tapeworm is an example of an organism living off a host, hence the 'say?'.

clue.text: Large cushions started to go in the middle — a lot!

indicators.note: the central letter of the word for started is to go

parts.note: began means started
bags of something means a lot of it

explanation.surface: Someone started to shift, with plenty of upheaval along the way.
explanation.definitionFit: Floppy fabric sacks filled with pellets are used as large floor cushions for sitting on.

clue.text: Odd bits of carbon, sulphur, steel and cement, possibly, for me?

indicators.note: odd bits takes the first, third and fifth letters of the word carbon

parts.note: S is the chemical symbol for sulphur
steel is a poetic word for a blade
cement is one example of something that sets hard

explanation.surface: A list of building materials and chemical elements, with the setter wondering what they all have to do with them.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter of the puzzle refers to themself as 'me'.
explanation.definitionFit: The 'me' of the clue is the compiler, the person who made this very puzzle.

clue.text: English invading, Ned has front limbs equipped for battle? You must be prepared!

indicators.note: invading means the abbreviation for English enters the phrase for battle

parts.note: for battle is read as for war
the name is taken as written
has, as in Ned's, contracts to the same form as Ned is
equipped with front limbs, with arms ready to fight: fore-armed

explanation.surface: An English attack on a man named Ned, who has bravely armed himself for combat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ned has' is read as 'Ned's', which can also stand for 'Ned is', giving IS.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb means that knowing about trouble in advance lets you get ready for it, an exhortation to be ready.

clue.text: Those known by experts to hold sanctimonious views

indicators.note: to hold means the outer word wraps around the letters for sanctimonious

parts.note: an expert is said to know their onions
pi is a short informal word for pious, sanctimonious

explanation.surface: Pundits harbouring smug, holier-than-thou views.
explanation.walkthrough: The British idiom 'to know your onions' means to be expert at something.
explanation.definitionFit: Views and beliefs that someone holds are synonyms here: personal judgments or standpoints.

clue.text: Eternal youth has to fade — savage!

parts.note: to peter out is to fade away
to pan a show is to savage it in a review

explanation.surface: Youth cannot last for ever: it is bound to fade, which is brutal.
explanation.definitionFit: J M Barrie's character is the boy who never grows up, a byword for perpetual boyishness.

clue.text: See 12
No one annoyed about wear and tear

indicators.note: about tells us to turn the assembled letters right round

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
sore can mean annoyed, aggrieved

explanation.surface: Nobody is irritated by the wear and tear things suffer over time.
explanation.definitionFit: Gradual wearing away by friction or weather is the damage caused by use or exposure.

clue.text: See 2
Male leaving a horrible drink for Roman general

indicators.note: leaving means the letter for male departs from the word for horrible

parts.note: grim means horrible, dreadful
cola is a fizzy soft drink

explanation.surface: A man walks out on a ghastly drink offered to a Roman commander.
explanation.definitionFit: Gnaeus Julius Agricola was the Roman governor of Britain famed for his campaigns in Scotland.

clue.text: Still fashion designs about right for formal wear

parts.note: even, as in even more, means still

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go around the abbreviation for right
to fashion is to shape, so the letters of designs are reshaped

explanation.surface: Fashion designers are still working on outfits for a formal occasion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fashion' turns DESIGNS into INGDESS, which goes 'about' R.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothes worn to formal evening events, such as gowns and dinner jackets, are formal wear.

clue.text: Get lost somewhere in India on the road

parts.note: Goa is a state on India's west coast
a way is a road or route

explanation.surface: Losing your bearings in India while travelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are blunt commands telling someone to leave you alone and depart.

clue.text: Rise in temperature believable

indicators.note: in signals that the letters sit within the words temperature believable

explanation.surface: A credible report of a rising temperature.
explanation.definitionFit: To rise up is to revolt, so it is a verb synonym for taking up arms against authority.

clue.text: Time to fill bottles, say

indicators.note: bottles means the word for fill holds the abbreviation for time inside it

parts.note: to sate is to fill to satisfaction

explanation.surface: It is time to fill bottles, perhaps with wine.
explanation.definitionFit: To state something is to declare or express it in words, a synonym for the verb.

clue.text: Permission for a minor change of plan, as centre not being rebuilt

indicators.note: a change of plan means the letters of the following words are altered
being rebuilt reinforces that the letters are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: A council allows a small alteration to the plan, since the centre is not being reconstructed after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone under eighteen often needs a mother's or father's agreement, a guardian's approval for under-age activities.

clue.text: American's excellent rendition, like a shot, ends

indicators.note: ends takes the final letter of each of the four words before it

explanation.surface: An American praises a performance that finishes as quickly as a gunshot.
explanation.definitionFit: In US slang the word is used as an exclamation of approval meaning great or cool.

clue.text: Literary work losing focus for the present time

indicators.note: the focus is the central letter of the word, which is dropped

parts.note: a novel is a book-length work of fiction

explanation.surface: A book that has lost focus, set in the present day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the present time' looks like 'now' but is the season of gifts.
explanation.definitionFit: Christmas is the season of giving presents, punningly the present time.

clue.text: See 4
